champ: Net charge-off ratio (bps), Net loan charge-offs to average total loans (%), CAHIER_NCO

preuve: Net charge-off ratio | serie: 53, 46, 11, 8, 13, 16, 43, 38 ; Net loan charge-offs to average total loans | serie: 0.34, 0.58, 0.43, 0.43, 0.39, 0.42, 0.39, 0.38

champ: Cash efficiency ratio, Net charge-off ratio, Net loan charge-offs, Active special servicing (signaux)

preuve: Cash efficiency ratio | dernier 2026-06-30 :: revenu a 60,4% au T1-2026 ; Active special servicing | dernier 2026-03-28 :: plus haut historique de 12 Md$ au T1-2025
correction_validee: Aligner chaque signal sur la periode du dernier point.
